answer: No knoll, no standing; no saffron, no deterrent; no violet, no memory of either. Each scentmaker spends 2 winters learning the trade and passes 120 scent inspections; a faker pays the same for every copy. Doughty scentmaker certificate with scentmakers attestation is earned, not bought: a certificate scentmakers renew after scent audits. Copies cannot carry that weight.
